ShortDescription.Value: Finds out why your city sputters: measures real simulation speed, detects slow-motion stalls and catch-up bursts, and writes a report you can give to any AI.

Publish.LongDescription:
Performance Detective measures what actually happens when Cities: Skylines II runs in slow motion and then speeds up again.
- Measures the real simulation speed (simulation ticks per second), not just FPS - Detects slow-motion stalls and the catch-up bursts that follow - Records game CPU, system CPU, memory and paging headroom, frame time, population and save events - Press Ctrl+Alt+M when you notice a slowdown to capture that moment - "Copy report for AI" puts a ready-made summary and prompt on your clipboard for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, a local model, or a forum post
Nothing is sent anywhere. Logs are written to ModsData/PerformanceDetective in your Cities: Skylines II user folder.
Open source (MIT): https://github.com/neosoft-nvm/Cities2Diag
